name: Zachariah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Zachariah the son of Jeroboam over the northern kingdom in Samaria, six months, and he did what we do best, which is evil.
Zachariah son of Jeroboam reigns over Israel only six months and does that which is evil, not departing from the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: “In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.” Remember Uzziah reigned fifty-two years, so in his thirty-eighth year Zachariah reigned over the Northern Kingdom in Samaria, for six months. Why six months?

note.label: Gentiles: What Happened to Northern Kingdom?
